# Rise and Battle the Day

## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
The alarm goes off, and the battle begins. Before your feet hit the floor, the enemy is already at work—whispering that you can hit snooze, that today doesn't matter, that you can coast. But Paul's charge to the Corinthian church wasn't a suggestion; it was a command. *Act like men. Be strong.* Notice the order: watchfulness comes first. A soldier who sleeps through the watch is a liability to everyone beside him. The same is true spiritually. When you drift through your morning without prayer, without Scripture, without intention, you've handed the day over before it starts.

Strength isn't measured by how much you can lift—it's measured by whether you show up when it's hard. Faithfulness in the small, unseen moments is what forges a man who can stand when the real trial comes. So today, don't wait for motivation. Take ground early. Pray before you scroll. Read before you react. Stand firm, and let your strength be rooted in the One who never sleeps.

## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups first thing this morning—before coffee, before your phone—and with each rep, thank God for the strength to face today.
